text_evidence.probe_recipes.py:
"""Run the added budget recipes and immediate loop recovery checkpoint."""

import json
import re
import shlex
import shutil
import subprocess
import sys
import tempfile
from pathlib import Path

root = Path.cwd()
sys.path.insert(0, str(root / "scripts"))
from check_docs import block

audit = root / "target/audit/next-pass"
work = Path(tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix="recipe-probes-", dir=audit))
shutil.copyfile(root / "target/code-tracer.jar", work / "code-tracer.jar")
guide = (root / "docs/guides/tracing.md").read_text()
loop = (root / "docs/tutorials/trace-a-loop.md").read_text()
(work / "SnapshotDemo.java").write_text(block(guide, "recipe-snapshots-source"))
(work / "Loop.java").write_text(block(loop, "loop-source"))
records = []


def run(name, command, expected=0):
    args = shlex.split(command)
    filename = None
    if ">" in args:
        i = args.index(">")
        filename = work / args[i+1]
        args = args[:i]
    p = subprocess.run(args, cwd=work, capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=60)
    (audit / (name + ".stdout")).write_text(p.stdout)
    (audit / (name + ".stderr")).write_text(p.stderr)
    if filename:
        filename.write_text(p.stdout)
    assert p.returncode == expected, (name, p.returncode, p.stderr)
    records.append({"name": name, "command": command, "exit": p.returncode,
                    "stdoutBytes": len(p.stdout.encode()), "stderr": p.stderr})
    return p


commands = re.findall(r"^java -jar code-tracer.jar trace -i SnapshotDemo.java --all-breakpoints --format modern (?:--max-snapshots 20000|--unlimited) > (?:raised-limit|unlimited-trace).json$", guide, re.M)
assert len(commands) == 2
for index, cmd in enumerate(commands):
    data = json.loads(run("budget-recipe-" + str(index), cmd).stdout)
    assert data["steps"] and data["steps"][-1]["stdout"] == "8\n"
for index, flags in enumerate(["--unlimited --max-snapshots 1", "--max-snapshots 1 --unlimited"]):
    p = run("budget-explicit-precedence-" + str(index),
            "java -jar code-tracer.jar trace -i SnapshotDemo.java --all-breakpoints --format modern " + flags, 3)
    assert not p.stdout
locations = json.loads(run("loop-checkpoint", block(loop, "loop-locations")).stdout)
assert locations and next(x for x in locations if x["lineNumber"] == 4)["validBreakpoint"]
(work / "Loop.java").unlink()
p = run("loop-missing-input", block(loop, "loop-locations"), 1)
assert not p.stdout and (work / "locations.json").stat().st_size == 0
(audit / "recipe-probes.json").write_text(json.dumps({"commands": records,
    "sourceInputs": {"SnapshotDemo.java": block(guide, "recipe-snapshots-source"),
                     "Loop.java": block(loop, "loop-source")},
    "nativeWindows": "Static review only"}, indent=2) + "\n")
print(json.dumps({"commandsPassed": len(records), "work": str(work)}, indent=2))
